units.source_text: 千重子今年没去参观岚山的迦陵频伽。

en.t: Chieko did not go to Arashiyama this year to see the kalavinka.

units.source_text: 她总觉得这些活动缺乏古雅的风趣。

en.t: She always felt that such events lacked an old-fashioned elegance and charm.

units.source_text: 因为京都古色古香的盛会很多，她几乎都看不过来呢。

en.t: Kyoto had so many grand events rich in old-world atmosphere that she could hardly see them all.
